name: tula-closeline-portal
description: Closeline portal: the dashboard web app

scripts.build:verify: VITE_ENVIRONMENT=local VITE_AUTH_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 VITE_CORE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3002 bunx --bun vite build --outDir out/verify
scripts.check: biome check src scripts test vite.config.ts
scripts.generate:check: bun scripts/generate-api.ts --check && tsr generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/routeTree.gen.ts
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run generate:check && bun run build:verify && bun run shared:check
scripts.verify:changed: biome check --changed --no-errors-on-unmatched src scripts test vite.config.ts && bun run typecheck && bun run test
